newsitem.title: USA: Network Solutions Inc names chief executive.
newsitem.headline: Network Solutions Inc names chief executive.

text.p: Cable & Wireless Inc Chief Executive Gabe Battista resigned to become chief executive of Network Solutions Inc, the two companies said Wednesday.
Battista, who had been president of Cable & Wireless since 1995, was replaced by Alan Peyser, the company's former chief executive and director who retired in August 1995.
At Network Solutions, Battista fills a position that has been vacant since March 1995, when the company was purchased by Science Applications International Corp.
Cable & Wireless Inc is owned by Cable and Wireless Plc.
